title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 1, section 5 (Lucy Island)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 1 No Shooting, Hunting or Trapping Areas (Section 2)
Lucy Island
5 That portion of the Province, in the vicinity of Langara Island, Queen Charlotte Land District, that is within the following boundaries: All of Lucy Island above the low water mark, designated as Lot 678, Queen Charlotte Land District.
